SELECT dept_seq, office_seq, parent_dept_seq, dept_code, dept_name, dept_path, depth, sort_ord, use_yn, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at, del_yn, note FROM utb_dept_mst WHERE dept_seq = #{deptSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert:
SELECT fn_get_dynamic_seq('utb_dept_mst')
INSERT INTO utb_dept_mst ( dept_seq, office_seq, parent_dept_seq, dept_code, dept_name, dept_path, depth, sort_ord, use_yn, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{deptSeq}, #{officeSeq}, #{parentDeptSeq}, #{deptCode}, #{deptName}, #{deptPath}, #{depth}, #{sortOrd}, COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.update:
UPDATE utb_dept_mst
dept_name = #{deptName}, dept_code = #{deptCode}, parent_dept_seq = #{parentDeptSeq}, dept_path = #{deptPath}, depth = #{depth}, sort_ord = #{sortOrd}, use_yn = #{useYn}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE dept_seq = #{deptSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'
UPDATE utb_dept_mst SET del_yn = 'Y', update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE dept_seq = #{deptSeq}

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT dept_seq FROM utb_dept_mst WHERE parent_dept_seq = #{deptSeq} AND del_yn = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT d.dept_seq FROM utb_dept_mst d INNER JOIN descendants p ON d.parent_dept_seq = p.dept_seq WHERE d.del_yn = 'N' ) UPDATE utb_dept_mst SET use_yn = #{useYn}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE dept_seq IN (SELECT dept_seq FROM descendants)
UPDATE utb_dept_mst SET dept_path = REPLACE(dept_path, #{oldPath}, #{newPath}), update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND dept_path LIKE #{oldPath} || '%' AND del_yn = 'N'
